notes.text: mtg-jp prints card names in Japanese (Power, duals and other old cards in English); `name` is the English name, checked against Scryfall and mtg-jp's own English export, and `printed_as` the Japanese as printed. Every list matches mtgtop8's English copy from BIG MAGIC card for card.

mtg-jp gives no placings or archetypes. 1st and 2nd are from the final report (Jumonji beat Sekimoto, who was 1st after the Swiss); 3-4 and 5-8 and the archetypes are from mtgtop8's copy of the organizer's (BIG MAGIC) results. Only Sekimoto's seed is stated. English names are romanized from the Japanese.
mtgtop8 also has a duplicate of this event (e=20072) with machine-translated names ("Ryoji Cross" for Ryo Jumonji) and different archetypes.
